# stub

> A stack-agnostic stub generator. A `.stub` directory of LiquidJS templates plus a `templates.json`
> manifest becomes CLI commands that render files into your project. The output is just text, and
> everything stub knows about your stack lives in your project, never in stub.

Install: `npm install -g @bitperfect-software/stub`. Requires Node >= 20.19.

## Docs

- [Full reference](https://bitperfect-software.github.io/stub/documentation.md): the manifest format,
  inputs, `requires`, the filters, the `{% path %}` and `{% reference %}` tags, the error messages, and
  what is deliberately not implemented in 0.1.0.
- [README](https://github.com/bitperfect-software/stub/blob/main/README.md): install and a 30-second
  example.
- [Documentation site](https://bitperfect-software.github.io/stub/): the same reference as a web page.

## Examples

- [basic](https://github.com/bitperfect-software/stub/tree/main/examples/basic): one variable, a
  Liquid-rendered path, two filters.
- [module](https://github.com/bitperfect-software/stub/tree/main/examples/module): computed values, a
  template-local computed that shadows a global, a switch, transitive `requires`, both cross-reference
  tags and a `{% render %}` partial.
